run_friction_cone_simulation: run the pybullet friction cone demo that spawns 40 spheres with circular velocity patterns on a plane
configure_cone_friction_physics: configure the pybullet physics engine to enable cone friction for realistic sphere sliding behavior
change_sphere_dynamics: change sphere dynamics parameters including lateral friction, linear damping, and angular damping via changeDynamics
trace_sphere_trajectory: trace a sphere trajectory by stepping the simulation and drawing debug lines between positions
reset_base_velocity: reset a body base velocity to set initial linear velocity in x, y, z directions
